SECTION 1

* Young people in the UK are often criticized by older generations for spending money on things like holidays or eating out, instead of saving every penny for a house deposit.

* Housing prices have gone up significantly while banks are less willing to give mortgages, making it nearly impossible for many young people to ever buy their own home.

* Many young people feel trapped paying rent to landlords forever, while those same older homeowners call them irresponsible with money.

* People under 25 years old in the UK are legally allowed to be paid less money per hour than older workers, even when doing the exact same job.

* Young workers are more likely to have unstable jobs with zero-hours contracts (meaning no guaranteed work hours), making it even harder to save money or plan for the future.
